info.title: Famxplor Family Travel API
info.description:
Welcome to the [Famxplor](https://famxplor.com) Family Travel API Developer Documentation!

This guide will provide you with all the necessary information to integrate with the Famxplor API and access family travel activities with kids worldwide.

The **[Famxplor Family Travel API](https://famxplor.com/api)** offers:

* Seamless access to curated family travel activities from around the globe.
* Kid-friendly travel suggestions tailored to your users.
* Opportunities for developers, travel platforms, and businesses to enhance their offerings with family-focused content.

Whether you're building a travel website, mobile app, AI agent, or integrating into an existing platform, the Famxplor API empowers you to deliver family-friendly travel ideas that parents and kids will love.

### Access to this documentation

Too see this documentation check the [ReDoc version](/redoc) or [Swagger UI](/docs).

### Import in Postman

If you prefer to test the API on Postman, you can import the API using the URL: [https://api.famxplor.com/openapi.json](https://api.famxplor.com/openapi.json)
See the official Postman's documentation [Import Swagger APIs](https://learning.postman.com/docs/getting-started/importing-and-exporting/importing-from-swagger/).

### Authentication

To access the Famxplor API, you must include an **API key** in the request headers:
1. [Get your API key here](https://www.famxplor.com/api)
2. Include the key in headers as shown in this example:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.famxplor.com/v1/nearest-posts" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"lat":48.85341,"lon":2.3488,"max_distance":100000}'
```

### Language of the results

The `Accept-Language` HTTP header can be used to request a specific language for the results.

If not specified, the default language is English.

Accept-Language Format:

The `Accept-Language` header value is a single language code.
The language code is a two-letter abbreviation, like `en`, as specified by [ISO 639](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639_language_codes).

If the specified language is not available, results will be returned in English.

Example:

To request content in the French language (code: `fr`) using `curl`, add the following command line options:

```
-H 'Accept-Language: fr'
```

### Unknown fields

Unknown fields in responses should be ignored.
This allows introducing new properties while keeping existing code functional.

The square is one of the largest pedestrian areas in Europe and is surrounded by cafes, restaurants, and shops.
